name: filenest
description: Filenest: upload, organise, preview and share your files from any device
author: Yusuf Hussain

scripts.services: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --wait && npm run bucket --prefix server
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run server --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
